functions.name: parse_geojson
functions.does: Parse a GeoJSON document into a validated point feature collection, rejecting non-Point geometries.

functions.name: features_to_records
functions.does: Flatten a point feature collection into entity records with lat/lon fields and carried properties.

functions.name: records_to_rows
functions.does: Pivot a set of entity records into a columns-and-rows table with a stable column order.

functions.name: fetch_tiles
functions.does: Fetch the map raster tiles covering an area of interest under a fetch policy.
